name: Oldsmar
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Oldsmar, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Oldsmar, Florida for 2026: a tree lighting, Winter Wonderland, Breakfast with Santa and a golf cart and bike parade.
lede: Oldsmar's city calendar fills the first half of December with a tree lighting, a snowy Winter Wonderland, Breakfast with Santa and a golf cart and bike parade.
celebrates: The City of Oldsmar's online calendar opens the season with the City Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Hall on November 30, then Winter Wonderland at R. E. Olds Park on December 4. Saturday, December 12 is the big day: two Breakfast with Santa seatings at the State Street Center, then the Holiday Golf Cart and Bike Parade from the Oldsmar Public Library at 6 pm, where entry is $5 per cart or $10 per family of up to four bikers.
lastyear: The City of Oldsmar's 2025 calendar listing described Winter Wonderland as the coolest event of the year, with a giant snow slide, bounce houses, concessions and a visit from Santa himself. The 2026 listing carries the same name and the same park.
facts: The City of Oldsmar's calendar lists each Breakfast with Santa seating as its own entry at the State Street Center, 127 State Street West, and says the price includes admission, the meal, a gift and photos with Santa. The Oldsmar Public Library at 400 St. Petersburg Drive East is the start of the golf cart and bike parade.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Oldsmar. The closest is Largo's Rudolph Limited holiday train, listed on our Largo page, and the Florida Railroad Museum in Parrish and the Henry B. Plant Museum in Tampa are on our museum guide.
train_links: A heritage railroad museum south of Tampa Bay, listed on our museum guide.
The Tampa museum in the old Tampa Bay Hotel, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: The city lights its tree at City Hall on November 30.
A December 4 evening at R. E. Olds Park.
Two December 12 seatings at the State Street Center.
Holiday Golf Cart and Bike Parade
A December 12 evening parade from the library, with family bike entry.
kidfact: Oldsmar's parade lets a family of up to four ride decorated bikes for one $10 entry.
faq: The city holds a tree lighting on November 30, Winter Wonderland on December 4, Breakfast with Santa on December 12 and a golf cart and bike parade that evening.
Is there a Santa breakfast in Oldsmar?
Yes. The city lists two seatings on December 12, at 9 and 10 am, at the State Street Center.
How much does the Oldsmar parade cost?
Entry is $5 per golf cart and $10 per family of up to four bikers, according to the city calendar. The calendar lists no spectator fee.
At R. E. Olds Park, on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 5 to 8:30 pm.

intro_html:

The magic runs from November 30 (the City Tree Lighting Ceremony) through December 12 (Breakfast with Santa and the Holiday Golf Cart and Bike Parade), with Winter Wonderland (December 4) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Oldsmar
